rules.description: After IFD approval, the PD maker must prepare a Sanction Order for each payment file and forward it to the Checker.
rules.outcome: PD maker will prepare Sanction Order against each payment file and send them to the Checker
rules.evidence_quote: Subsequent to IFD approval, the PD maker will prepare Sanction Order against each payment file and send them to the Checker.

rules.description: The Checker must digitally sign each payment file received from the PD maker.
rules.condition: After receiving the Sanction Order from the PD maker
rules.outcome: Checker will digitally sign each file
rules.evidence_quote: The Checker will digitally sign each file and, thereafter, the DDO of the Ministry/Department will tally details, generate eBills and digitally sign them.

rules.description: Following the Checker's digital signature, the DDO must tally details, generate eBills, and digitally sign them.
rules.condition: After the Checker digitally signs each file
rules.outcome: DDO of the Ministry/Department will tally details, generate eBills and digitally sign them
rules.evidence_quote: The Checker will digitally sign each file and, thereafter, the DDO of the Ministry/Department will tally details, generate eBills and digitally sign them.

rules.description: The PAO must verify and digitally sign eBills before forwarding them for payment through PFMS.
rules.condition: After eBills are generated and digitally signed by the DDO
rules.outcome: PAO will verify them, digitally sign them, and send them for payments using PFMS
rules.evidence_quote: The eBill will, thereafter, be sent to PAO who will verify them and digitally sign them before sending them for payments using PFMS.

rules.description: Scholarship payments must prioritize Aadhaar‑based transfers; if unavailable, payments are made to beneficiaries' verified bank accounts.
rules.outcome: Priority given to Aadhaar based payment; failing that, disbursal will be made to verified bank accounts of the beneficiaries
rules.evidence_quote: For disbursal of scholarships priority will be given to Aadhaar based payment failing which disbursal will be made to verified bank accounts of the beneficiaries.

rules.description: All related activities for the three scholarship schemes must be finished by 31 December 2017.
rules.outcome: These activities will be completed by 31st December, 2017
rules.evidence_quote: These activities will be completed by 31st December, 2017 for all three scholarship schemes.
